141-1893-3899.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1893-3899.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

957-7370-7874.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling The Immortal Weapons.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning The Immortal Weapons from exile to the battlefield.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

500-2523-4772-7824.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Bard and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Bard token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Bards dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Bard that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Bards you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-745-1619-4661.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1619-4661.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirrorhall Mimic and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-4661.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-1251-1355.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-1251-1355.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a brain counter on it
with a brain counter on it

800-5536-6784.description:
Activate Rex using Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifact sources.
Activate Rex using Knacksaw Clique's ability by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to play that card this turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-3259-4742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2388-3259-4742.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-4485-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Docent of Perfection // Final Iteration
1618-2440-4485-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Docent of Perfection // Final Iteration triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-4485-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Docent of Perfection // Final Iteration. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3480-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
3259-3480-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
3259-3480-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

225-539-2908-3478.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Dream Stalker trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Repeat.

1251-3490-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1251-3490-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2034-3558-4053-6989.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more charge counters on it

304-1978-2593.description:
Animate Astral Cornucopia using Tough Cookie.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat from step 2.

874-4053-4740-6613.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4 if you've cast two or more spells this turn, 5 if you've cast one spell this turn, or 7 otherwise.
874-4053-4740-6613.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-4053-4740-6613.description:
Cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard by paying {0} and 3 life. It will not enter with a finality counter due to Solemnity.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve Delif's Cone, and it will not enter with a finality counter due to Solemnity.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat

478-765-2821-3664-3918.notablePrerequisites: Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-765-2821-3664-3918.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Guildless Commons.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

81-3869-4067.notablePrerequisites: Kami of Whispered Hopes does not have summoning sickness, and has power 4 or greater.
81-3869-4067.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.

1479-2374-4826-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2374-4826-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2499-4499-4939.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Burning-Tree Emissary.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

635-1339-2757.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
You control a basic Island.
635-1339-2757.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Drowned Rusalka by paying {U} and sacrificing another creature, causing you to rummage.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Insect, untapping the basic Island.
Repeat.

125-507.description:
Any time a player would cast a spell from their hand it gets exiled from possibility storm.
Rule of Law prevents them from casting the other card from possiblity storm resulting in a lock.
